title: Membership Tenure Bonus on Summit Choice-Benefit Miles
content:
A choice-benefit bonus credit in the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program carries a tenure bonus that follows the whole years since the membership's enrolment date, a year being complete on the anniversary of that date.

1. Enrolled 10 or more whole years ago: 2000 miles added.
2. Enrolled 5 to fewer than 10 whole years ago: 1000 miles added.
3. A younger membership: no tenure bonus.

The tenure bonus is a fixed number of miles added to the miles the credit carries.

**Hypothetical boundary.** A membership enrolled on 1 September 2016 has 9 whole years on 31 August 2026 and adds 1000 miles; on 1 September 2026 it has 10 whole years and adds 2000 miles. A membership enrolled on 1 September 2022 adds nothing on 1 September 2026.
